postingTitle: Einstein The Parrot Takes His Interview Very Seriously 🦜
narrationScript: Einstein is an African grey parrot with a microphone habit he takes very seriously. Perched at Zoo Knoxville, he leans into every question like a tiny celebrity at a press conference. Between the head tilts and the chatter, he answers in his own unmistakable voice. Not bad for an interviewee who works entirely for treats.
